vectorConvention.u: eastward component, positive = blowing toward the east
vectorConvention.v: northward component, positive = blowing toward the north
vectorConvention.note: This is the 'blows toward' meteorological vector convention, NOT the 'wind direction' compass convention ('a north wind' = FROM the north, TOWARD the south) -- see docs/climate-v1-wind-validation.md section 15.

fields.u: annualMeanU -- time-mean of the eastward component (a monsoon reversal cancels toward 0 here)
fields.v: annualMeanV -- time-mean of the northward component
fields.annualResultantSpeed: sqrt(annualMeanU^2 + annualMeanV^2) -- speed of the annually-averaged vector
fields.meanScalarSpeed: time-mean of sqrt(u^2+v^2) computed per calendar month BEFORE averaging -- always >= annualResultantSpeed; the gap is what an annual-mean-vector model cannot see
fields.djfU: Dec-Jan-Feb mean U (future use -- not analysed this stage)
fields.djfV: Dec-Jan-Feb mean V (future use -- not analysed this stage)
fields.jjaU: Jun-Jul-Aug mean U (future use -- not analysed this stage)
fields.jjaV: Jun-Jul-Aug mean V (future use -- not analysed this stage)

mask.method: the pre-computed 850hPa ltm file was checked directly and does NOT come pre-masked below ground (unlike the full monthly-mean record, which does) -- so the mask is built here instead, from the same product's own surface-pressure ltm climatology: a cell is masked wherever its annual-mean surface pressure is under 850 hPa. Applied once (not seasonally) to every 850hPa field alike. Never interpolated or filled.
mask.appliesTo: level850hPa only; level10m has no topographic mask (10m is always above the surface by definition)
